<translate>
The '''Capsule Corp Namekian''' is the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]] counterpart of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]]. It lives in its own house inside the '''Ajissa villages''' of Planet Namek and works as a structure locator, selling treasure maps to Namek's landmarks.
</translate>

<translate>
== Treasure maps ==

Each map trade can be used up to 8 times.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Map to</translate> !! <translate>Cost</translate>
|-
| <translate>Frieza's Ship</translate> || <translate>1 Tier-1 Radar Chip</translate>
|-
| <translate>Grand Elder's House (Elder Guru)</translate> || <translate>1 Healing Bucket</translate>
|}

<translate>
Every map points at the nearest structure of its kind with a red X. If that structure hasn't been placed in the world yet, the trade shows as '''out of stock''' and turns into a real map once the structure can be located; re-open the trade window to check again.

For the map to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]], see the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Trader]].
</translate>
